terms.meaning: One full swing of a pendulum: from one end to the other and back.
The time a pendulum takes to complete one oscillation.
The small weight hanging from the thread of a pendulum.
The distance an object covers in a unit of time.
Moving in a straight line at a constant speed.
Moving in a straight line while the speed keeps changing.

items.name: Sundial
items.formula: Tells the time from the position of a shadow.
items.example: The Samrat Yantra at Jaipur is a giant stone sundial.

items.name: Sinking bowl water clock
items.formula: A bowl with a tiny hole fills and sinks in 1 ghati = 24 minutes.
items.example: A day of 24 hours has 60 ghatis, because 60 × 24 minutes = 24 hours.

items.name: Finding the time period
items.formula: Time period = Total time ÷ Number of oscillations

items.name: What changes the time period?
items.formula: Only the length of the pendulum at a given place. A longer pendulum has a longer time period.
items.example: A heavier bob on the same thread does not change it.

items.name: Galileo and the swinging lamp
items.formula: Galileo timed a swinging lamp with his pulse and saw that each swing took the same time.
items.example: Huygens later used this idea to build the pendulum clock.

items.name: SI unit of time
items.formula: The second, written s. 1 min = 60 s and 1 h = 3600 s.

items.name: Writing units correctly
items.formula: Small letters, singular, no full stop, and a space after the number.
items.example: Write 5 s, not 5 secs or 5 sec.

items.name: Speedometer and odometer
items.formula: Speedometer: speed in km/h. Odometer: distance travelled in km.
items.example: A speedometer may read 60 while the odometer reads 12000.

items.name: Telling the motions apart
items.formula: Equal distances in equal times: uniform. Unequal distances: non-uniform.
items.example: 5 m every second is uniform. 2 m, then 5 m, then 9 m is non-uniform.

mistakes.text: A heavier bob does not change the time period. Only the length does.
One oscillation is there and back. A swing from one end to the other is only half of it.
Average speed is total distance ÷ total time, not the mean of the speeds. 60 km in 1 h and then 60 km in 3 h is 120 ÷ 4 = 30 km/h.
An odometer shows distance, not speed. A speedometer shows speed.
